conviction_note: Q2 sales are pre-released by the 月次 (Q2 全社 +2.2%, 既存店 +2.6%, H1 +3.0%), Q1 showed OP +12% on SG&A leverage against a 0.3pt gross-margin squeeze, and this company has not revised its plan mid-year even when H1 already exceeded the full-year number (FY2/26), so the print most likely lands as an H1 OP around 1.4bn yen with the plan held, ~85-87% progress like last year; findings sum +0.2 and the scaled number is +0.08 (p_up 52 on 2.0 abs), both near zero because nothing here is unpriced.
bar: No sell-side consensus or 四季報 number reachable; the bar is the company FY2/27 plan (sales 88,600m, OP 1,670m, OrdP 1,600m, NP 450m, no H1 plan disclosed) from the Q1 決算短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589902.pdf, plus last year's H1 (sales 43,372m, OP 1,324m) from https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2698. print_vs_bar is H1 sales growth (~+3.0% per 月次) against the plan's +1.8% growth path. Single-source bar, so every size is capped small.

No options, no skew. run_up_20d -4.31%, 5d -0.16%; priced_lean +0.215. AEON holds 51.04% (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260629/140120260629582908.pdf), so float is ~49% and retail/優待 heavy.

findings.finding: Q2 (Jun-Aug) sales are already visible and modestly positive: 全社 +2.2%, 既存直営店 +2.6%, H1 cumulative +3.0% / +3.3%, with Q1 having converted +3.8% sales into +12.0% OP via a 0.5pt SG&A-ratio cut (self-checkout, 人時 control); continued SG&A leverage puts H1 OP plausibly at ~1.40-1.45bn yen vs 1,324m last year, ~85-87% of the FY plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY2/27 (OP +12%) bought +1.29% and a YTD high (kabutan n202607100321); last year's H1, which already exceeded the FY plan with no revision, moved +1.56 (baseline, estimated date); H1 FY2/25 moved -3.94.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the sales half is public in the 月次 and the stock rose on the September release (kabutan n202610080739). What is not visible is the Q2 margin; if the Q1 SG&A leverage carried, kabutan's auto-headline will read H1 profit up with high progress vs the plan, which has lifted this name on the last two equivalent prints. A fully priced version would show a run-up into the print; the 20d run-up is -4.3%.
findings.independence: Q1 短信 (different document) for the SG&A-ratio mechanism: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589902.pdf

findings.finding: Gross margin pressure likely continued in Q2: Q1 GM fell 0.3pt on raw-material costs, and the yen sat near 160/USD through August before strengthening to ~155 in early September, so Q2 procurement for a fixed-price 100-yen assortment was at a weak yen.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY2/26: GM missed plan on cost inflation but SG&A cuts covered it and the stock rose 3 days on the 2026-04-08 revision (kabutan n202604090293); the market has looked through GM pressure when OP held.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission, a hypothesis: the yen level is public and the stock was bought as a strong-yen beneficiary in September, which, if anything, prices the H2 relief rather than the Q2 squeeze. Small because the Q2 GM is not disclosed until the print and the company offset it with SG&A last year.
findings.independence: Q1 短信 GM -0.3pt statement: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589902.pdf (company document, different source)

findings.finding: No forecast revision is likely at this print: in FY2/26 the company left its OP plan of 1,080m unchanged at H1 (actual 1,324m) and at Q3 (3Q cumulative above the FY plan) and revised only on 2026-04-08; the FY2/27 plan (OP 1,670m) implies an H2 of ~200-270m, in line with last year's H2 of 208m, so a held plan is the base case and the September 既存店 +1.1% gives no reason to raise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Held plans with high progress: H1 FY2/26 +1.56, 3Q FY2/26 +1.58 (baseline, estimated dates; kabutan k202601080018 headline '通期計画を超過'). The only revision (2026-04-08, OP +41.7%) bought 3 straight up days.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the habit is in the public record and held plans have been bought, not sold. Filed at zero because it sets what the release can add (nothing on guidance, almost certainly nothing on returns: interim 8.5 yen unchanged for years) rather than a direction.

baseline_tension: Agrees with a flat lean: no shorts, no margin data, a -4.3% 20d drift after the August 優待 record date; the strongest positive the release could carry is a held plan with ~87% progress and an OP-up headline (looked for, and it is the base case), the strongest negative a Q2 GM squeeze from the ~160 yen, and neither is unpriced enough to lean on.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (negative resting on a series the market already has): the GM-pressure finding rests on public Q1 data and a public yen level, cut from -0.2 to -0.1; the no-revision finding rests on the public revision record, cut from -0.1 to 0.0.
Rule 2 (check the sign): wrote the strongest positive (held plan, high progress auto-headline) into baseline_tension; I had looked for it, so p_up stays at 52 and abs_move at 2.0, unchanged.
